request: Update the planner so that ALL run_command steps must generate real, executable shell commands. Disallow placeholders like 'test suite for planner'. Enforce that commands must be directly runnable in the local environment (e.g., 'python -m pytest tests/'). Add validation logic so any non-executable command is rejected before execution.
title: Enhance planner to enforce executable shell commands
goals: Modify the planner to ensure all run_command steps generate real, executable shell commands
Remove any placeholders like 'test suite for planner' from run_command steps
Implement validation logic to reject non-executable commands before execution
constraints: Commands must be directly runnable in the local environment
Do not allow any placeholder text in the run_command steps
success_criteria: All run_command steps produce shell commands that execute without errors in a local environment
No placeholders are present in any run_command steps
Validation logic successfully identifies and rejects non-executable commands
